name: klipperlearn-printer-optimizer
description: Review real 3D-print calibration evidence and create Quality, Standard and Speed slicer profiles without controlling a printer.

interface.shortDescription: Three slicer modes from real print evidence
interface.longDescription: Free, open-source assistance for reviewing original calibration photographs and logs, proposing bounded experiments, and generating Quality, Standard and Speed process/filament presets for OrcaSlicer. No publisher account, paid API, phone or mandatory printer service. Other slicers receive a settings report. The user reviews and supervises physical trials; no automatic printer actuation or guaranteed gains. ChatGPT availability and usage limits still apply.
defaultPrompt: Review my printer's real calibration photos and logs, keeping layer height and geometry unchanged.
Create Quality, Standard and Speed OrcaSlicer presets from my reviewed trial records.
